integrity: The universal proof uses explicit global simplicial collapses. Executable finite examples corroborate but are not the proof. No independent review or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple base graphs, minimum degree at least three, girth at least five; the claim concerns Lovász open neighborhoods, not closed-neighborhood Čech or clique complexes. Absolute priority beyond inspected evidence is not asserted.
title: Star-boundary sphere wedges in open-neighborhood complexes of high-girth line graphs
